title: Beyond Cooperative Simulators: Generating Realistic User Personas for Robust Evaluation of LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2605.12894v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in settings where they interact with diverse users, including those who are unclear, impatient, or reluctant to share information. However, collecting real interaction data at scale remains expensive. The field has turned to LLM-based \emph{user simulators} as stand-ins, but these simulators inherit the behavior of their underlying models: cooperative and homogeneous. As a result, agents that appear strong in simulation often fail in real human interactions. To narrow this gap, we introduce Persona Policies (PPol), a plug-and-play control layer that induces realistic behavioral variation in user simulators while preserving original task goals. Rather than hand-crafting personas, we employ an evolutionary coding agent to discover persona generation programs optimized for human-likeness and behavioral coverage over real user conversations. translated_title: 超越合作型模拟器：生成逼真的用户角色以实现对大语言模型智能体的稳健评估
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越多地被部署在与多样化用户交互的场景中，这些用户包括表达不清、缺乏耐心或不愿分享信息的用户。然而，大规模收集真实交互数据仍然成本高昂。该领域已转向基于大语言模型的用户模拟器作为替代方案，但这些模拟器继承了其底层模型的行为特征：过于合作且行为同质化。因此，在模拟环境中表现优异的智能体在真实人际交互中往往表现不佳。为了缩小这一差距，我们引入了Persona Policies（PPol），这是一个即插即用的控制层，能够在保留原始任务目标的同时，为用户模拟器引入逼真的行为变化。我们不再手工设计用户角色，而是采用进化式编码智能体来自动发现角色生成程序，该程序基于真实用户对话，针对人类相似度和行为覆盖范围进行优化。进化得到的程序可以生成……（摘要截断）
tldr: 提出了一种即插即用的控制层Persona Policies（PPol），利用进化式编码智能体自动发现角色生成程序，使LLM用户模拟器产生逼真且多样化的用户行为（如表达不清、缺乏耐心等），从而弥补模拟与现实之间的差距，实现对LLM智能体更稳健的评估。
en_tdlr: Persona Policies (PPol), a plug-and-play control layer that employs an evolutionary coding agent to automatically discover persona generation programs, enabling LLM user simulators to exhibit realistic and diverse user behaviors (e.g., unclear, impatient users) for more robust evaluation of LLM agents beyond cooperative simulators.
